additional_info.subject: ID0388074-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R2 312722681/04] Terminal is out of service CRM:00642001742
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing great.
In order to troubleshoot the Failsafe mode error, please follow the instructions below.
1.Please check with the help of MobaXterm to see what all IP's we're getting from each components, if one of the component IP is not coming, then we have investigate that component.
2. Make sure the KF1 is in RUN state & reinsert the power terminal correctly.
3. Check for the FC15 fuse connection that is coming to the below snap as attached.
4. Kindly check thoroughly all the connections of
XD10.1A & XD10.1B
terminal.
5.Check the connection on the 24V DC bridge terminal to ensure it is not causing any power supply issues to SECC.
6.Inspect for any loose connections to the OCPP router and the LAN cable of the router.
7. Make sure all the ethernet cables are well tighten to the ethernet switch & subsequent components connection in between.
Additionally, I am providing a link to a knowledge article for your reference; please review it.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_SW_PLC,SECC_Failsafe mode error - Dynamics 365
Awaiting your feedback once all the above actions are performed.
